name: paired box 7
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PAX7 encodes paired box protein Pax-7. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and anatomical structure morphogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to myopathy, congenital, progressive, with scoliosis (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Rhabdomyosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
